source_note: 全陵群一条。孝陵1663动工，1664主体完工、1668附属完成；具体牌坊年代在成稿再核。

Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  SUBJECT: the grand WHITE MARBLE STONE PAILOU (stone ceremonial archway) at XIAOLING, Eastern Qing Tombs, Zunhua, Hebei, late1660s. Reproduce this actual frontal archway in image2 as one complete isolated monument. SIX tall square stone posts create FIVE open rectangular passage bays. FIVE large upper roofed units arranged symmetrically with central highest, two intermediate, and two lower outside; plus SIX smaller post-top roofed caps interleaved below, making ELEVEN distinct roof caps in total. This is a stone five-bay eleven-roof PAILOU, not a temple facade. Keep stone beams with sparse carved panels, lofty proportions, stepped pedestals at all six columns, open WHITE voids behind all five passages. historical_sources.title: 历史年代与现存主体依据
历史年代与现存主体依据
王其亨《康熙朝〈孝陵图样〉解读（上）》建筑史学刊，1671运石、1672石牌坊落成

site_recommendation.name: 清东陵
site_recommendation.yearNote: 按所绘石牌坊采用1672：王其亨据《孝陵图样》及运石档案考证1671年底运输构件、1672初落成。孝陵1663—1664早期主体工程与传统1668附属工程记载不作为此石牌坊年。
site_recommendation.coordinate_source: Commons实拍 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:清东陵石牌坊_-_panoramio.jpg 公布相机点40.145608,117.681508；取其北方石牌坊附近40.146,117.6815作约百米精度图鉴定位，非测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 五间六柱十一楼的石牌坊立在孝陵神道南端，以一连串高低错落的石屋顶开启清东陵的礼仪序列。

facts.label: 营建
facts.text: 建筑史学者王其亨据档案考证，石牌坊在康熙十一年（1672）初落成。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 五个开间、六根石柱、十一座高低错落的楼顶，构成完整仿木石牌坊。

facts.label: 收录范围
facts.text: 清东陵全陵区为一条记录；本图以孝陵神道石牌坊作代表，不把各帝陵拆分。

coordinates.source: Commons实拍 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:清东陵石牌坊_-_panoramio.jpg 公布相机点40.145608,117.681508；取其北方石牌坊附近40.146,117.6815作约百米精度图鉴定位，非测绘坐标。

quality_check.notes: 核对六柱、五通道、十一楼顶（五大六小）与完整石基，稀疏细线无填黑。
